narration:0:1620985001:1.text: You close your eyes. Through the cold coffin, you sense a faint but familiar trace of magic.
narration:0:1620985001:1.source_cn: 你闭上双眼。透过冰冷的棺椁，你感受到了一丝微弱却熟悉的...
narration:0:1620985001:1.male: You close your eyes. Through the cold coffin, you sense a faint but familiar trace of magic.
narration:0:1620985001:1.female: You close your eyes. Through the cold coffin, you sense a faint but familiar trace of magic.

say:2:1620985002:1.text: <u><link=Case><style=highlight>There's a residue of magic on this coffin. It's faint, but it was definitely here. This signature... feels so familiar.</style></link></u>
say:2:1620985002:1.source_cn: 棺材上留有一点魔力痕迹。很微弱，但的确存在过。这种气息...

say:3:1620985003:1.text: Was that left by whoever dug it up? Who could it have been...?
say:3:1620985003:1.source_cn: 这会是挖出棺材的人留下的吗？到底是谁呢……
